title: A site of invented statistics is still being retrieved by ChatGPT
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT is still opening pages of made-up statistics
summary: Peec AI researcher Metehan Yesilyurt says he published about 50,000 invented statistics in March 2026, at a cost of about $50. He says Google largely dropped the site, while ChatGPT's page-opening bot kept fetching the pages months later, including more than 70,000 fetches in a recent 30-day window. He reports more than 10,000 sessions from ChatGPT and links from more than 330 domains, and says made-up figures later appeared in an academic paper and in a bank's investment research. He presents the work as a warning about citations, not as a method to copy.

He says Google mostly stopped showing the site, but ChatGPT's page-opening bot kept fetching the pages months later. He reports more than 70,000 of those fetches in a recent 30-day window, more than 10,000 visits from ChatGPT, and links from more than 330 other sites. whyItMatters: A precise number in an AI answer is not a source. If a figure matters for a decision, open the page it came from and ask who measured it. A later citation from a paper or a bank can make a guess look checked.
